question: What are the top 5 items with the highest year-over-year growth percentage in total sales revenue for the year 2023?
sql:
-- Get top 5 items by YoY growth percentage (2023 vs 2022)
WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2022 AND bottles_sold >= 0 THEN sale_dollars ELSE 0 END) as sales_2022,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2023 AND bottles_sold >= 0 THEN sale_dollars ELSE 0 END) as sales_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
    AND bottles_sold >= 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  sales_2022,
  sales_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(sales_2023 - sales_2022, sales_2022) * 100 as yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly_sales
WHERE sales_2022 > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
